annotations.title: List the Journal Officiel issues of a year

description: List the issues of the Algerian Journal Officiel for one year: for each issue its number, whether the French and Arabic editions exist with the links to their official PDF files on joradp.dz, and whether UpGrowth holds its summary. For Morocco (country MA) it lists the issues of the Bulletin officiel for one year, from 1912: for each issue its number, its publication date and the links to its French and Arabic editions on sgg.gov.ma (editions.fr and editions.ar, each with available true or false and pdf_url); a supplement (bis, ter) is listed beside its issue, with its suffix. For Tunisia (country TN) it lists the issues of the JORT for one year, from 1956: for each issue its number within the year, its publication date and whether its French and Arabic editions exist; the official site gives no direct link to the PDF files, so pdf_url is null. Returns an error when no issue is indexed for the year. Use it to find the number of an issue, then get_jo_issue to see what the issue contains. Without an API key only Algeria answers, for the current year and the two before it (older years return key_required), and at most 10 issues come back: meta.truncated says when more exist.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

year.description: Year of the gazette: the Journal Officiel from 1962 for Algeria, the Bulletin officiel from 1912 for Morocco (country MA), the Journal Officiel de la République Tunisienne from 1956 for Tunisia (country TN). Find the years covered with list_jo_years. Without an API key only Algeria answers, for the current year and the two before it; older years come with a paid plan.
